story.iWant: to control which tabs are visible and their order
story.soThat: I only see domains I care about in my preferred sequence
story.tasks: - Store tab preferences in browser localStorage - Format: {tab_visibility: {videos: true, papers: true, ...}, tab_order: ["videos", "papers", ...]} - Dynamically generate tab bar based on preferences - Modal or offcanvas for customization UI - Default configuration includes all tabs in alphabetical order

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: - Given I open the dashboard, when I click "Customize Tabs" in settings, then I see a list of all available tabs with toggle switches - And I can hide/show tabs - And I can drag to reorder tabs - When I save my preferences, then only visible tabs appear in my preferred order - And preferences persist across sessions - And I can reset to default tab configuration

ecosystem.name: javascript
ecosystem.packages: localStorage API, HTML5 Drag & Drop API, SortableJS library, CSS transitions

constraints.constraint: Tab customization changes must apply immediately without page refresh when saved
Corrupted localStorage tab preferences must fallback to default configuration
Tab customization UI must be fully keyboard accessible with proper ARIA labels
Drag-and-drop reordering must use consistent visual feedback and styling
Dynamic tab generation must not slow down initial dashboard load time
Tab customization must work on mobile devices with appropriate UI adaptations

interface.name: TabPreferencesManager
interface.signature: class TabPreferencesManager: savePreferences(visibility, order), loadPreferences(), resetToDefault()

tests.standards: UI testing for tab customization modal and drag-and-drop functionality. localStorage testing for preference persistence and recovery. Cross-browser testing for dynamic tab generation. Accessibility testing for keyboard navigation and screen reader compatibility.

ideas.idea: Test: Click "Customize Tabs" and verify modal shows all available tabs with correct toggle states
Test: Hide tabs and save, then verify only visible tabs appear in main dashboard
Test: Drag tabs to reorder, save preferences, and verify order persists after page refresh
Test: Reset to default and verify all tabs return to alphabetical order with visibility restored
Test: Test with minimum tabs visible (1-2) to ensure dashboard remains functional
Test: Navigate customization modal using keyboard only, verify proper focus management and ARIA announcements
